parse_compression_benchpress_output: parse stdout and stderr from a benchpress compression benchmark run to extract speed metrics
extract_geo_mean_comp_speed: extract the geometric mean compression speed in MB/s per compression level from benchmark output
extract_geo_mean_decomp_speed: extract the geometric mean decompression speed in MB/s per compression level from benchmark output
parse_silesia_corpus_names: parse silesia corpus names from benchmark output lines using regex pattern matching
review_CompressionParser_parse: review the CompressionParser parse method to understand how it computes geometric mean speeds across compression levels
